banner.title: cert-manager
banner.tagline: Issues and renews the wildcard certificate every Gateway serves, through Let's Encrypt DNS-01 on Cloudflare.

art.about: how a TLS certificate is issued
art.title: How cert-manager issues TLS

explainer.title: From a DNS proof to a certificate on every Gateway

steps.title: Token
steps.text: ExternalSecret cloudflare-issuer pulls the Cloudflare DNS token from 1Password item cloudflare.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Certificate sklab-dev-production asks ClusterIssuer letsencrypt-production for the apex and *.domain.
steps.scene: a certificate document with a wildcard star

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: cert-manager writes an _acme-challenge TXT record in Cloudflare and checks it over DNS-over-HTTPS.
steps.scene: a globe with a DNS record card labelled "TXT"

steps.title: Sign
steps.text: Let's Encrypt reads the TXT record and signs a 90-day certificate. The TXT record is removed.
steps.scene: a large seal stamping the certificate

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Secret sklab-dev-production-tls feeds the HTTPS listeners of envoy-internal and envoy-external.
steps.scene: two gateway arches with a padlock

facts.label: left when the expiry alert fires
